task.title: [M6] Operator frame selection, PTS provenance and timing separation
task.description:
**Project:** RO Sprite Forge (oq6fp33cmdnwl5h0v48zcr3u)
**Milestone:** M6
**Stable plan reference:** RSF-v1.1/M6-02
**Implementation status:** Accepted after independent QA_PASS; all four live criteria verified.
**Responsible implementer:** Codex — aM3as9DCoQ7pMoO3V9XsDbL3q2j9pWjn. Independent reviewer: separate read-only forge_qa_reviewer context /root/rsf24_qa.
**Source reference:** docs/architecture/RO_SPRITE_FORGE_COMPREHENSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v1.1.md §§2.1–2.3, 5.3, 6/M6
**Planning source SHA-256:** 5edfbebcdb47620c59a915e8874094f35092125dd0444b79468aa55a191a361e

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Let the operator choose actual video frames for existing finite requirements.

**Scope:** Video timeline/keyframe candidate selection, explicit mapping, crop/alpha placement and source provenance UI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Operator selects display-order frames and maps to declared action/view/frame/layer IDs; retain source hash, source PTS, selected frame hash and selection revision.
- [x] Show source PTS independently from ACT/runtime playback timing, including VFR and candidate gaps.
- [x] Manual placement/crop/alpha choices use versioned M4 recipes and before/after previews with affected approval invalidation.
- [x] No missing poses/views are inferred, auto-filled or aesthetically accepted; selection and review remain operator actions.

## Verification

Selection/reopen provenance tests, VFR timeline and runtime-timing separation checks; operator review flow.

Record actual commands, environment/tool versions, exit statuses, artifact hashes and NOT_RUN blockers at handoff. Actual results follow below; no real artwork approval or new native run is claimed.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-28 (M6-01; task ID mdehayoorrfc43z930ij72wx); RSF-18 (M3-04; task ID reuc1z3obcspcrn7xb55dzvk)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** Only the stated deliverable; no adjacent milestone implementation or automatic artistic/native acceptance.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence (add at QA handoff)

- Changes: existing video adapter metadata factoring, exact HTTP DTOs, revision-aware preview/staging, local workbench video controls, tests and documentation. Exact 13 changed paths and SHA-256 values: docs/verification/rsf-29/implementation-manifest.json (805b5d8241f2b14b93ec5e92ea9627d37a0b8062b2338919793b1df2e7c7d51e); 121 baseline files unchanged. No commits/pushes.
- Verification: 26 focused +26 existing media tests, 504 public PASS; private 40 PASS/1 legacy skip; 11 schema scripts PASS; installed distribution 504 discovered/494 PASS/10 optional skips. All exit 0. Actual coordinator Playwright MCP and separate reviewer Chromium journeys PASS. Commands and logs: docs/verification/rsf-29/commands.json and REPORT.md. Final wheel c04263a2e178182f6bd1a4aca07414286423ba172d0c6e2909cf6c8deaa05ef4.
- Scope: exact VFR PTS [300,0,120] resolves [4,0,2]; explicit ordering preserved, previews do not commit, confirmed staging/reopen/manual assignment work. Source timing remains independent of ACT timing. M4 crop/placement/alpha previews and scoped review invalidation verified. Exact metadata decimal strings; supported selection bound ±(2^53−1), larger requests rejected. No automatic assignment/approval. M0–M5 accepted scope retained; Rust/native GPU NOT_RUN for this UI slice; M6 remains open.

## Independent QA result (reviewer reports, coordinator syncs)

QA_PASS — separate configured forge_qa_reviewer /root/rsf24_qa independently executed backend/public/private/schema/distribution checks, fresh Chromium primary/workflow journeys and known-pixel/derived-image probe. All four live criteria PASS. No mandatory source defect; generated PKG-INFO inventory omission corrected and refreshed seal independently verified. Reviewer made no edits, Kaneo writes or ownership changes. Report: docs/verification/rsf-29/independent/QA_REPORT.md. Large-PTS/capability browser presentations simulated, backend tests independently cover exact persistence/tool absence. Human artistic authority unchanged.
